verdict_text: YES. The script verifies name equality across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality on every non-MLP tensor via `assert torch.equal(...)` (satisfying step 1 and the "shared-tensor verification" required check) before performing any merge. It applies the exact merge formula `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` with λ=0.4 in float32 to precisely the 48 MLP tensors matched by the layer regex, leaves all other tensors as bit-identical copies from `base`, and asserts `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114` as required. It writes a single `model.safetensors` to `out/T4` (the default when invoked with no argument, matching the specified invocation), producing 114 keys total with unchanged names.
